Subject: Re: Vendor setup: Zephyr Supply tax docs & EIN

Greg —

Thanks for sending these over and for filling out the portal. Quick heads-up from our payments/tax side: the company name on the EIN letter reads "Zephyr Supplies, LLC" while your W-9 is written as "Zephyr Supply Co." That mismatch prevents automatic EIN reconciliation in our AP system and is why the PO is currently held.

Can you confirm the legal entity name (registered with the IRS) and provide one of the following to resolve:
- a copy of the Articles of Organization/Certificate of Formation showing the exact legal name, or
- a short notarized DBA declaration if you operate under a trade name, or
- an updated W-9 matching the EIN letter.

I've looped in Monica from Procurement to keep the PO thread active and Kimberly from Payments to do the reconciliation once you send the document. We will keep the PO on hold until the name/EIN match is resolved — once we receive a matching doc we'll attempt an expedited release.

For transparency: HubSpot record HS-54219 updated with the discrepancy and a note added to the supplier file.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the note and sorry for the confusion. We recently completed a minor legal name change last quarter (operating entity is still the same EIN). The IRS letter was requested under the former legal name. I've attached a brief DBA declaration plus an updated W-9 that lists the legal name as "Zephyr Supplies, LLC" with the DBA "Zephyr Supply Co." This should align the records.

Attachments: DBA_declaration.pdf (application/pdf), W-9_Zephyr_Supply_updated.pdf (application/pdf)

Elena — copied — will confirm if you need anything else from our tax/legal team. We appreciate the quick turnaround on the PO.

Best,
Greg
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Greg —

Got the updated W-9 and the DBA declaration, thank you. I forwarded the docs to Payments and Tax for reconciliation. Kimberly, can you please confirm whether the DBA declaration plus the updated W-9 are sufficient to re-run the EIN match and release PO #PO-87321? If there's anything missing we should ask Zephyr for (notarized certificate, state filing, etc.), let us know.

Greg — we will do our best to expedite; Montegomery (our Payments lead) is on standby. Expect an update by end of day tomorrow.

For your records, I've added the finalized attachments to the supplier folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bZephyrOnboarding and left a note in HubSpot (HS-54219).

Quick next steps for you: if you have a scanned state filing (Certificate of Formation) it speeds the process — otherwise the DBA plus updated W-9 is typically acceptable.

Thanks again,
Logan Wright
